brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: ads-marketing / editorial sports illustration.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball article thumbnail, landscape 16:9, ideally 1600x900 or larger. Fully opaque PNG.
Style: bold hand-drawn ink-and-dry-brush sports editorial art, visibly illustrated, NOT photographic. Near-black #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B, warm ivory. Orange only for the basketball. Coarse ink hatching, restrained paint texture, few elements, strong Japanese typography. Approved style was a black-and-lime basketball editorial poster, but vary the composition: player on the LEFT and typography on the RIGHT.
Subject: the real professional basketball player Kerry Blackshear Jr. (ケリー・ブラックシアー・ジュニア), not a fictional person. His official Gunma profile portrait has been visually inspected. Likeness traits to match carefully: tall powerful broad-shouldered build; dark skin interpreted in black/ivory ink; very closely cropped black hair with neat hairline, NOT tall curls; strong broad slightly elongated face, defined jaw; short dense close-trimmed beard following the jaw and chin, subtle mustache; thick brows, deep-set focused eyes, broad nose, full lips. Preserve recognizable facial proportions; do not use the curly-haired player in the style example.
Pose: dynamic three-quarter upper-thigh-up rebound-protection / pivot illustration. Both hands naturally securing ONE basketball near his upper chest, elbows bent and torso twisting, face clearly visible above the ball and turned slightly toward viewer. The player is the visual protagonist; no other players. Anatomically sound five-finger hands, two arms, realistic athletic shoulders. Keep his head, hands, and ball entirely inside the frame. Wear a plain dark basketball jersey with ivory brush-lit folds and restrained lime edge highlights, no logos, no jersey number, no team or sponsor lettering. A broad sweeping lime brush arc behind the body suggests movement; no actual arena, scoreboard or identifiable game moment.
This is an imagined illustration inspired by the article statistics, NOT a recreation of a documented game scene.
Typography: elegant but forceful heavy Japanese Gothic, accurate and very legible. No crowded elements, no text crossing the face. On right, date at top, large ivory headline, exceptionally large lime number 46 with smaller EFF. Below that player surname and team. Footer in ivory, readable, with safe padding. Minimum 5% safe margin for all text.
Render EXACTLY the following visible text, preserving Japanese glyphs, punctuation, digits, with no other text:
Top small brand: "バスケまとめ"
Top/date: "2026.10.26"
Large headline: "貢献度1位"
Dominant statistic: "EFF 46"
Player line: "ブラックシアー・ジュニア"
Team line: "群馬"
Footer line 1: "イラスト（AI生成）｜成績をもとにしたイメージ"
Footer line 2: "※記録は公式訂正で変更の場合あり"
Arrange the player name on one line if practical; do not reduce its size excessively.
Content source facts only from fixed supplied article: on October 26, Kerry Blackshear Jr. of Gunma ranked first in EFF with 46. EFF is NOT points scored. Do not add 46得点, MVP, decisive shot, victory claims, additional stats or other names. Do not copy any performance numbers, date or identity from the style example. Do not reproduce or paste any official photo, any team/league logo, sponsor mark or watermark.

SINGLE CORRECTION
Edit the first input image, the finished black/lime Japanese basketball thumbnail. Second input is the official Gunma profile photo of Kerry Blackshear Jr., used ONLY to guide facial likeness.
Make one targeted identity correction to the illustrated player: match the official portrait's broad face, substantial jaw, full lips, broad nose, thick brows, deep-set eyes and very closely cropped hair more faithfully. The first image's beard is too long and bulky under the chin: shorten it to the close-trimmed beard along the jaw and chin seen in the second reference, retaining the subtly trimmed mustache. Keep the athlete recognizable as Kerry Blackshear Jr. Draw the new face with the SAME visibly hand-drawn ivory/black ink hatching as the first image, NOT as a pasted photograph and not photorealistic.
Keep the dynamic pivot / ball-protection pose, the powerful build, plain unbranded uniform, single basketball, layout, black #151A18 and lime #CCF43B brushwork, and ALL lettering EXACTLY unchanged. Both hands should remain naturally gripping the ball with anatomically plausible five-digit hands.
Do not import the official photo's pose, jersey logos, sponsor lettering, jersey number, earrings or photographic texture.
Retain all exact text:
"バスケまとめ"
"2026.10.26"
"貢献度1位"
"EFF 46"
"ブラックシアー・ジュニア"
"群馬"
"イラスト（AI生成）｜成績をもとにしたイメージ"
"※記録は公式訂正で変更の場合あり"
Preserve the current landscape 16:9 canvas and resolution, all text fully within frame, same overall design. Exactly one finished image.
